profile.headline: Marketing & Operations at The Green Enchilada
profile.summary:
Graduate of San Jose State University with a Bachelor's Degree in Marketing with various Computer Science courses mixed into my curriculum. Completed the UC Berkeley's Full-Stack Developer program. Aspiring to become a software engineer.

My passion in technology and business as well as my hunger for knowledge is what drives me to explore and develop new skill sets, learn to become comfortable being uncomfortable, and constantly competing with myself. I'm always looking to improve my skills, no matter the opportunity.

positions.title: Marketing & Operations
positions.description:
* Lead marketing efforts — social media, promotions, and local advertising — to attract customers and build community
engagement.
* Ran 2 online ad campaigns; daily sales rose from a typical ~$1.8K to $2.5K–$3K while the ads were running.
* Communicate with vendors and guests and step into front-of-house and management duties as needed.

positions.title: Server
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Handled 8–14 tables per shift depending on section, building quick rapport with guests, recommending menu items and
specials, and resolving concerns on the spot.

positions.title: Software Engineer (L3), Opstical Website
positions.description:
* Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer working on next-generation Social Media & Collaboration Technologies products. Deputy to the Staff Software Engineer serving as Technical Architect & Team Leader for the Business Unit.
* Operated within a dynamic, agile environment to produce an elegant front-end user interface hosted on a high-availability, bare metal Linux server environment.

Languages & Tech Stack:
JavaScript Family of Languages & Technologies - React.js, TypeScript, Redux,
Version Control, Deployment, & Delivery - GitHub, GitHub Actions, & CircleCI
Testing - Postman, JEST
Libraries, Interfaces, & Standards - GraphQL & MaterialUI
Data - MySQL & TypeORM

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Worked with the Marketing team to drive engagement and retention by implementing seasonal promotions, gift card redemptions, and various marketing events and campaigns.
• Maintained a strict record of all active and expired Certificates of Insurance, on an Excel Sheet, of all vendors and contractors so all parties are aware of liability coverage.
• Worked with the Property Analyst to collect monthly sales reports from all vendors at the beginning of each month and updated an Excel sheet containing the master sales report.

positions.title: Certified Training Course Support
positions.description:
• Acted as a point-of-contact for all our training course instructors by providing them with customized books/reading materials, catered meals, and a list of all attending students.
• Supported potential clients and students through Zendesk, while maintaining 99% positive feedback, with any questions or concerns regarding our classes.
• Created all public training courses online by publishing the course landing pages, setting up the courses through Wordpress, and making the course available to the public for sign-ups
• Sent targeted messages and set parameters set to product managers seeking certification in scrum living nearby course locations through LinkedIn to acquire customers and consistently made an 85%+ sign-up rate.

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Utilized WordPress to update information on landing pages and fix broken links/graphics.
• Collaborated with a cross-functional marketing and sales team to operate two trade show booths and developed positive experiences with attendees that resulted in over 1000s of leads for the sales team to convert.
• Responsible for creating email drip campaign templates to send out to a pool of leads on Pardot with a score of 70 or lower. Those with a score above 70 were delivered to sales.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: Brought on for a large time-sensitive project aimed to be completed in three months and performed office support activities for my supervisor. Primary duties include: Convert all previous files to fit an entirely new file system with new folders and labels. As well as, data-entry, word processing, and labeling.

projects.title: Integrated Marketing Communications Plan
projects.description:
• Developed a marketing plan for a local business, Crema Coffee Roasting Co.
• Exceptional teamwork by defining clear roles based on strengths and weaknesses, keeping open line of communication, and meetings set often.
• Ability to craft and present data driven analyses and marketing recommendations to owners to increase sales and improve brand awareness.
